The live interactive sessions are delivered in the regional language, focusing on Foundational English, Mathematics, and Science. The program is designed for Grades 5 to 10 students with an equal emphasis on co-scholastic learning outcomes. Volunteers are selected based on the languages they know to help children in their local language. All the centres have an electricity supply besides having installed inverters and solar panels to ensure uninterrupted power. Volunteer teachers come from diverse professional backgrounds who teach from the comfort of their homes and offices. To act as the extended arm of the volunteer teachers, every eVidyaloka classroom has a Class Assistant. This Class Assistant, also called the CA, is picked from the locality and trained to operate the digital infrastructure and support the volunteer in conducting classes, thus creating a job opportunity in rural India for every eVidyaloka Digital Classroom. Evidyaloka Digital Classroom Program Digital Classroom program that enables access to quality education with digital content to 75-100 students per rural government school through online live sessions delivered by passionate volunteer teachers with the help of interactive content modules.
